title_zh: 约定先核实篮子纹样的代表范围

scenario.label_zh: 约定先核实篮子纹样的代表范围
scenario.goal_zh: 核对虚构目录中的制作者归属，并约定在确认前不把一个篮子的纹样推广到整个部族

context_zh: 博物馆课程使用虚构部族与物品目录训练标签写作，避免把个体作品当作整个群体的统一特征。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: The catalogue says this basket was made by a member of the Aruni tribe. Can I call the pattern a typical Aruni design?

sentences.speaker: Dr Bell
sentences.text: Not from that information alone. Does the catalogue say whether other makers used the same pattern?

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: No. It gives the maker's name, says they're Aruni and records where the basket was collected. It doesn't mention patterns used by other makers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Bell
sentences.text: Then keep those details. We should ask the curator what evidence there is for a wider claim.

sentences.speaker: Carmen
sentences.text: I'll do that. Until we have an answer, the label will describe this basket, not the whole tribe.

sentences.speaker: Dr Bell
sentences.text: Exactly. A precise label can still be interesting without claiming more than we know.
